name: BHBA
aliases: (±)-3-hydroxybutyric acid, (+/-)-3-hydroxybutyric acid, (RS)-3-hydroxybutyric acid, 3 HBA, 3-hydroxy-butanoic acid, 3-hydroxy-butyric acid, 3-hydroxybutanoic acid, 3-OH-butyric acid
summary: β-Hydroxybutyric acid, also known as 3-hydroxybutyric acid or BHB, is an organic compound and a beta hydroxy acid with the chemical formula CH3CH(OH)CH2CO2H; its conjugate base is β-hydroxybutyrate, also known as 3-hydroxybutyrate. β-Hydroxybutyric acid is a chiral compound with two enantiomers: D-β-hydroxybutyric acid and L-β-hydroxybutyric acid. Its oxidized and polymeric derivatives occur widely in nature.

pharmacology.text: D-β-Hydroxybutyric acid, along with butyric acid, are the two primary endogenous agonists of hydroxycarboxylic acid receptor 2 (HCA2), a Gi/o-coupled GPCR. β-Hydroxybutyrate is primarily carried via two classes of transporters: monocarboxylate transporters (MCTs) and sodium-coupled monocarboxylate transporters (SMCTs).

summaryZh: β-羥基丁酸，又稱3-羥基丁酸，化學式： CH3CHCH2CO2H，是一種羥基酸。β-羥基丁酸具手性，有兩種對映異構物：D-3-羥基丁酸和L-3-羥基丁酸。此化合物在人體飢餓狀態時的低血糖生理反應中，扮演重要角色。

uses.en: It is sold as a supplement for ketogenic diets and sports, and its salts are studied for epilepsy and for metabolic disease. It is also a diagnostic marker measured in diabetic ketoacidosis.
uses.zh: 它作為生酮飲食與運動用補充品販售，其鹽類也因癲癇與代謝疾病而被研究。它同時是糖尿病酮酸中毒時檢測的診斷指標。
uses.zhHans: 它作为生酮饮食与运动用补充品贩售，其盐类也因癫痫与代谢疾病而被研究。它同时是糖尿病酮酸中毒时检测的诊断指针。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects of the supplements include stomach upset, nausea and diarrhoea, and the salts carry a lot of sodium. In people with uncontrolled diabetes, a build-up of ketones in the blood is ketoacidosis, which is a medical emergency.
sideEffects.zh: 補充品回報的反應包括腸胃不適、噁心與腹瀉，而其鹽類含有大量鈉。對血糖控制不良的糖尿病患者而言，血中酮體累積即為酮酸中毒，屬於醫療緊急狀況。
sideEffects.zhHans: 补充品回报的反应包括肠胃不适、恶心与腹泻，而其盐类含有大量钠。对血糖控制不良的糖尿病患者而言，血中酮体累积即为酮酸中毒，属于医疗紧急状况。

fact.en: Beta-hydroxybutyrate is a ketone body: when the body runs short of carbohydrate, the liver makes it from fat so that the brain has a fuel it can use. This is what a ketogenic diet is built around.
fact.zh: β-羥基丁酸是一種酮體：當身體碳水化合物不足時，肝臟會由脂肪製造它，為大腦提供可用的燃料。生酮飲食正是圍繞這一點設計的。
fact.zhHans: β-羟基丁酸是一种酮体：当身体碳水化合物不足时，肝脏会由脂肪制造它，为大脑提供可用的燃料。生酮饮食正是围绕这一点设计的。
